about: 511.org is the San Francisco Bay Area traveler information site. This CLI reads its public transit and traffic data without an API key: transit and traffic alerts, agencies, transit centers, bike share, carpool spots, road speeds and the stop-ID finder.

commands.summary: List current Bay Area transit service alerts for all agencies. Filter the output yourself by ServiceAlertEntities[].AgencyId (e.g. BA=BART, SC=VTA, CT=Caltrain, AC=AC Transit).
List active Bay Area traffic events (incidents, construction, closures) with road, direction, severity and schedule.

params.name: road_segments
params.description: Include road segment geometry/details for events

params.name: road_closed
params.description: Include road-closure events (the map sends true together with road_segments)

commands.summary: Get the site-wide alert ticker: the current critical alerts and major closures shown at the top of 511.org.
List breaking traffic news and scheduled closure announcements, with descriptions and expiry dates.
Search Bay Area transit agencies by name and mode. Returns description, modes, the detail-page URL (slug), the stop-ID finder link and the transit-centers link (which carries the agency filter id).

params.name: train
params.description: Pass Train to limit to train agencies

params.name: bus
params.description: Pass Bus to limit to bus agencies

params.name: ferry
params.description: Pass Ferry to limit to ferry agencies

params.name: shuttle
params.description: Pass Shuttle to limit to shuttle agencies

params.name: subway
params.description: Pass Subway to limit to subway agencies (e.g. BART)

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort by name ascending or descending

commands.summary: List every transit agency with its 2-letter agency code (used in alerts' AgencyId and in the stop-ID finder) and whether it has real-time data.
Search transit centers and stations by name and/or the agency serving them. Returns names and detail URLs (slug), 10 per page.

params.name: agency
params.description: Numeric agency filter id or All. Take it from the centersUrl of list-transit-agencies, e.g. 146 = AC Transit

commands.summary: Get all transit centers in one JSON list, with address, coordinates, agencies served and shuttles.
Get a transit agency's detail page: description, website, address, phone, modes, paratransit link and how many transit centers it serves.

params.name: slug
params.description: Agency slug from the list-transit-agencies url, e.g. bart, caltrain, ac-transit

commands.summary: Get a transit center's detail page: name, address, agencies and info text, including links to route/stop/schedule maps.

params.name: slug
params.description: Transit center slug from the search-transit-centers url, e.g. millbrae-transit-center

commands.summary: List Bay Wheels bike share stations with live counts of available bikes and docks.
List casual carpool pickup and drop-off locations with address, description and coordinates.
Get live traffic flow (speeds, jam factor) for road segments inside a bounding box.

params.name: bbox
params.description: Bounding box west,south,east,north in degrees, e.g. -123.3,36.9,-122.4,37.8

params.name: functionalClasses
params.description: Comma-separated road classes, 1 = major highways up to 5 = local streets

commands.summary: Full-text search of 511.org pages (schedules, agency info, transit centers, programs). Returns page titles and URLs.
